skill.name: approve-work
skill.description: Approve an exact price, up to the maximum the person set. This starts paid work.
skill.summary: Authorize paid SpecStream work against a reviewed quote and an approved spending limit.
skill.author: specstream

security_audit.summary: The backtick and reconnaissance matches are false positives. The skill directs paid operations through the configured SpecStream endpoint, but there is no evidence of prompt injection or data exfiltration. It requires authority for the exact scope and limit without explaining how to verify who granted it.

remediation.issue: The skill directs paid operations to a remote MCP endpoint.
remediation.suggestion: Use only an administrator-approved SpecStream connection and verify that it points to the intended account before submitting a paid request.

remediation.issue: The skill does not specify how to verify standing spending authority.
remediation.suggestion: Verify the grant against a trusted approval record that identifies the approver, account, project, permitted scope, and spending limit. Stop and request explicit approval if any required detail cannot be verified.

content.value_statement: Approving paid web data work requires a reviewed price and spending authority. This skill submits the reviewed quote within the approved limit and checks the existing request when the response is unclear.
actual_capabilities: Submit a paid work authorization using the reviewed quote ID and quote hash.
Include the approved spending maximum as an integer number of cents.
Save a stable request key before submitting the authorization.
Look up the existing request or quote when an authorization response is unclear.
Check run progress and report results as they appear.
limitations: Requires a configured SpecStream MCP connection and a reviewed quote.
A funded account does not grant spending authority.
An expired or changed price needs new approval.
The skill does not add funds, start subscriptions, add seats, or open payment pages.

use_cases.title: Start a Quoted Research Run
use_cases.description: Use a reviewed quote to start a paid web data run within the amount approved for the research task.

use_cases.title: Apply a Project Spending Limit
use_cases.description: Check that standing project approval covers the exact quote scope and limit before authorizing paid work.

use_cases.title: Recover a Request After a Timeout
use_cases.description: Look up the original request before starting any further work so an unclear response does not create a second run.

prompt_templates.title: Approve a Reviewed Quote
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: One quote with an explicitly approved maximum.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use reviewed quote [quote ID] with hash [quote hash]. I approve up to [maximum cents] for this exact scope. Tell me whether the request started.

prompt_templates.title: Check Standing Approval
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: A project already has a spending approval record.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check [trusted approval record] for the scope and limit of reviewed quote [quote ID] with hash [quote hash]. Submit only if the record covers this work. Report what is missing otherwise.

prompt_templates.title: Recover an Unclear Submission
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: The authorization response did not confirm an outcome.
prompt_templates.prompt: Look up the original request for quote [quote ID] using the saved request key [request key]. Report its status without creating a new key, quote, or run.

prompt_templates.title: Authorize and Track a Run
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: A reviewed quote needs approval and progress reporting.
prompt_templates.prompt: Submit reviewed quote [quote ID] with hash [quote hash] within the confirmed limit of [maximum cents]. Save the request key before sending. Recover the same request if the response is unclear. Report progress and keep uncertain results marked as uncertain.

output_examples.input: Approve the reviewed quote for up to 750 cents.
output_examples.output: SpecStream accepted the request, and the run has started. The approved maximum is 750 cents.

output_examples.input: Check whether the authorization went through after the timeout.
output_examples.output: I found the original request. It is running, and no second run was created.

output_examples.input: Start the run even though the quoted price has changed.
output_examples.output: I did not start the run because the price changed. Please review and approve the new price.

best_practices: Verify that the approval covers the reviewed quote and the intended spending limit.
Save the same request key before submitting the authorization.
Look up the original request before taking further action after an unclear response.
anti_patterns: Treating a funded account as permission to spend.
Creating a new request key or run to recover an unclear response.
Reusing approval after a price changes or expires.

faq.question: What do I need before approving work?
faq.answer: You need a configured SpecStream MCP connection, a reviewed quote ID and hash, and authority for the exact scope and spending maximum.

faq.question: How do I specify the spending maximum?
faq.answer: Use a whole number of cents. For example, enter 750 cents for a maximum of 7.50 currency units.

faq.question: What happens if my approval expires or the price changes?
faq.answer: Review the current quote and obtain new approval before starting work.

faq.question: What happens if the authorization response is unclear?
faq.answer: The skill directs the agent to look up the existing request or quote without using a new request key or starting another run.

faq.question: Can this skill add funds to the account?
faq.answer: No. It reports missing funds and keeps the request without adding funds or opening a payment page.

faq.question: What happens to the results if a run stops?
faq.answer: The run keeps the results it has already found. SpecStream charges only for delivered matches.
